units: Targ. Y. Gen. XXX, 37 (v. פְּרַח I). [Targ. Job XX, 3, v. פּוּחָא.]—Esp. caper-blossom, also caper-tree.
<cite ref="Berakhot 36a:15">Ib. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>אדעתא דפ׳</he> for the sake of the caper.
Pes. 111ᵇ טולי בי פ׳ רוחי (the demons dwelling in) the shade of caper-trees are named ruḥé
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joel 1:4">Targ. Joel I, 4</cite> (h. text <cite ref="J00400"><he>ילק</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: *that which is blown off, particle, crumb.—Pl. פִּרְחַיָּיא.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 110a:14">Pes. 110ᵃ</cite> bot. (in an incantation) <he>פרח פִּרְחַיְיכִי</he> let the wind carry off your crumbs (with which you conjure; v., however, Rashi a. l.).
